name: Prism 12 - Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service
description: Read-only Microsoft Dataverse access (opportunities/deals, accounts, contacts) with strict entitlement gating, crmOrgUrl from orgConfig, and the standard Prism envelope. Refuses cleanly when disabled, unentitled, unconnected, or org URL missing.
